source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Clutch and Transmissions, p.7-3

procedures.title: Clutch assembly: install in vehicle
steps: Rotate the clutch until the cover's "X" mark matches the flywheel's "X" mark, then line up the cover bolt holes with the nearest flywheel holes.
Put a bolt in each hole and draw them down evenly and gradually until tight, so the clutch is not distorted.
Unhook the fork, grease the ball socket and the fork fingers at the bearing end with a high melting point grease such as graphite (Moly grease on Corvette), and refit the fork on the ball stud.
Pack the recess inside the throwout bearing collar and coat the throwout fork groove lightly with graphite grease (Moly grease on Corvette); see figure 3 in the manual.
Fit the fork and dust boot into the clutch housing, mount the throwout bearing on the fork, then install the flywheel housing.
Connect the fork push rod and spring.
Adjust the shift linkage (see transmission section).
Adjust the linkage for pedal free play and check the clutch release point.
notes: The grease slinger always faces the transmission side.
Figure 3 compares release bearings: the bent-finger type is 1-1/4" long, the other 1-7/8".

procedures.title: Clutch pedal
notes: The pendant clutch pedal hangs from a support brace shared with the brake pedal and has to come out before the brake pedal can be removed. Service is covered in Section 5. See figure 4 in the manual (Corvette linkage shown separately).

procedures.title: Clutch cross shaft: remove, repair and install
steps: Take off the linkage return spring and lower linkage springs, and unhook the pedal and fork push rods from their cross shaft levers.
Loosen the nut on the outboard ball stud and slide the stud out of the bracket slot.
Move the shaft outboard far enough to clear the inboard ball stud, then lift it out.
Inspect the nylon ball stud seats for wear or damage, and check the engine bracket ball stud assembly and its special anti-rattle O-ring; replace worn or damaged parts.
Grease the ball studs and seats with graphite grease before reassembly.
Adjust the clutch linkage as described earlier.
notes: See figure 5 in the manual for the lower linkage parts.
